summary: The candidate is mathematically correct and complete. The lattice fibers, saturated antipodal maximum matching, admissible center, support-minimal balanced circuit, exact minorants, and full-dimensional legal cap are all valid. The block law and exponential-moment argument give the claimed Bernstein bound with absolute constants uniformly in k, q, and r. The permutation-invariant Hamming construction has adequate mass and, after equal-mass floor/ceiling interpolation, exact every-coordinate marginals; this yields the common-barycenter core certificate in every fiber, including the zero-unscaled-factor case, only as a feasible lower bound for G. The singleton large-window estimate, exponent elimination, and exact q=1 identification also follow as stated.
